Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper

Class TransparencyOrderedGroup

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.SceneGraphObject
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.Node
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.Group
org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.j3d.j3dwrapper.TransparencyOrderedGroup
All Implemented Interfaces:
GroupWrapper, NodeWrapper, SceneGraphObjectWrapper, TransparencyOrderedGroupWrapper
public class TransparencyOrderedGroup extends Group implements TransparencyOrderedGroupWrapper
Provides the user control over the rendering order of transparent objects in the subgraphs of this Group. Transparent shapes in the 1st child of this group will be rendered before (ie behind) transparent shapes in the 2nd child and so on. Transparent shapes in the same child will be ordered using the standard test of distance to view.

    • setChildIndexOrder

      public void setChildIndexOrder(int[] childIndexOrder)
      Description copied from interface: TransparencyOrderedGroupWrapper
      Sets the childIndexOrder array. If the specified array is null, this node's childIndexOrder array is set to null. Its children will then be rendered in increasing index order. If the specified array is not null, the entire array is copied to this node's childIndexOrder array. In this case, the length of the array must be equal to the number of children in this group, and every entry in the array must have a unique value between 0 and numChildren-1 (i.e., there must be no duplicate values and no missing indices).
      Specified by:
      setChildIndexOrder in interface TransparencyOrderedGroupWrapper
      Parameters:
      childIndexOrder - the array that is copied into this node's child index order array; this can be null

    • addChild

      public void addChild(NodeWrapper child, int[] childIndexOrder)
      Description copied from interface: TransparencyOrderedGroupWrapper
      Appends the specified child node to this group node's list of children, and sets the child index order array to the specified array. If the specified array is null, this node's childIndexOrder array is set to null. Its children will then be rendered in increasing index order. If the specified array is not null, the entire array is copied to this node's childIndexOrder array. In this case, the length of the array must be equal to the number of children in this group after the new child has been added, and every entry in the array must have a unique value between 0 and numChildren-1 (i.e., there must be no duplicate values and no missing indices).
      Specified by:
      addChild in interface TransparencyOrderedGroupWrapper
      Parameters:
      child - the child to add to this node's list of children
      childIndexOrder - the array that is copied into this node's child index order array; this can be null
